about: Cases that pin Rerail's `stopBy: <rule>` to upstream ast-grep 0.45.3 (`rule/stop_by.rs`, `rule/relational_rule.rs`): `inside`/`precedes`/`follows` walk their axis up to and including the first node the stop rule matches; `has` tests a descendant the stop rule matches but does not enter it. The stop rule matches in a fresh environment. Each case runs through the CLI and both Rerail paths (the indexed path plans the unbounded relation as a superset). The no-invalid-this cases are TSLint's boundary: functions rebind `this`, arrow functions and methods' class bodies do not.
